free.title: Free for educators, always
free.body: Create a profile, get found, and never pay us anything.

fees.title: No placement fees
fees.body: Schools and families pay one flat membership for 12 months. We never take a cut of a salary or a lesson.

control.title: You control what's shown
control.body: Only paying members can see your profile. You choose what to share, and can hide or delete it in one click.

sensitive.title: No sensitive documents
sensitive.body: We never store IDs, criminal records or financial data. Share those directly, and only when you choose.

trust.title: A directory, not an agent
trust.body: We connect people. We do not screen, employ or guarantee anyone. Always verify credentials, work authorization and background checks directly before you hire or book.
